name: AmazonPublisherServicesMagniteAdapter
summary: APS Magnite Adapter for integrating Amazon Publisher Services with Magnite SDK
description:
The Amazon Publisher Services Magnite Adapter enables publishers to use APS demand with Magnite mediation.
This adapter allows you to integrate Amazon demand into your Magnite waterfall.
Learn more at: https://aps.amazon.com/aps/solutions-for-mobile-app-developers/
